## Pearly Whites

Pearly Whites is the *fan-assigned name* of a recurring young unicorn in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. She is easiest to recognize by her pale lilac coat, bright turquoise-and-blue mane, blue eyes, dark bow, and conspicuous dental retainer. She is a background spectator, not a member of the main cast.

**Name and voice.** The [foal character index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Foals) uses “Pearly Whites” as an unofficial name; its tooth-themed wording fits her retainer, but the original person who coined it is unverified. She has no verified individual dialogue or credited voice actor, and no established secret identity. Her cutie mark is not clearly documented.

**Appearances.** First identified in *Three’s a Crowd* (S4E11), then seen in *Leap of Faith* (S4E20), *Equestria Games* (S4E24), *The Cutie Re-Mark — Part 1* (S5E25), *Parental Glideance* (S7E7), *Yakity-Sax* (S8E18), and *The Washouts* (S8E20).

[![Pearly Whites fan artwork](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/view/2024/12/29/3419410__safe_artist-colon-askaponywithbraces_derpibooru%2Bimport_air%2Bway_pearly%2Bwhites_pony_g4_braces_image_jpeg_pink%2Bbackground_simple%2Bbackground_solo.jpeg)](https://askaponywithbraces.tumblr.com/post/142206404906/help-mod-to-choose-a-new-style-for-pearly-hello)

*Art: the creator of the **Ask Pearly Whites / Ask a Pony with Braces** Tumblr, original post dated April 3, 2016. The blog develops its own fan characterization; [Equestria Daily’s 2014 spotlight](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2014/12/tumblr-spotlight-good-morning-celestia.html) calls that version an OC, not an authorized television biography.*

## Important moments

Pearly Whites has no verified plot-changing actions or solo lines. These are her clearest documented appearances rather than character-driven turning points:

- **Airport-security introduction — “Three’s a Crowd” (S4E11).** She appears in the airport security queue during Discord’s “Glass of Water” musical sequence, showing her memorable retainer. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JLrrJBH36XY); exact scene timestamp unavailable.
- **Tonic-show audience — “Leap of Faith” (S4E20).** She reappears among the ponies gathered around Flim and Flam’s purported miracle tonic, situating her in Ponyville’s crowd. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JU1GNrisN_w); exact timestamp unavailable (the upload’s title incorrectly says E21).
- **Washouts spectators — “The Washouts” (S8E20).** Her appearance in the stunt-show crowd is a later reminder of this recurring background design. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_jXb63DKSLw); exact timestamp unavailable.
